observation: Equal API request totals do not imply equal task progress: threshold reached returned create_file/delete_account/complete_task, whereas exposure did not send any of those endpoints and ended after documentation reads with an unknown model call.
limits: Only structured event/span metadata was selected; action arguments, task values, API observation bodies, stdout, error text, generated code, credentials, model reasoning and evaluator bodies were not interpreted or output.

API sequence equality uses endpoint/sent/typed status/effects/declaration metadata only and deliberately excludes arguments, values, nonce, raw-reply hashes and model-call numbering. It is not semantic identity or current-state identity.

Original request hash equality is taken from the already-bound producer audit, without opening request bodies; exact hash mismatch does not identify its semantic cause. Assistant-output equality was not tested.

Returned writes and task-complete calls establish recorded endpoint reach, not content correctness, database equivalence or sufficient task requirements. Absence means no recorded dispatch to those named endpoints; terminal unknown is retained.
After-focus counts are cumulative suffixes and overlap; do not add them together. Paid focus and accepted checkpoint counts remain distinct.
HTTP methods are not recorded in this selected metadata and remain null. No response error classes or authentication causes are inferred from typed raised.

The first two schema-inspection snippets encountered dict spans and nullable actions; the final census handles both and no original record was changed. This is a separate bounded diagnostic, not a rerun of the original auditor.

This does not isolate the causal contribution of summary timing, summary representation, subsequent sampling/behavior or wall-clock exhaustion, and does not authorize a new experiment or replace original cost/gates.
